mesh_metadata.source_description: Woman by Francesco Laurana (ca. 1472). 3D scan of a cast from original in Berliner museum. It is a 3D scan of a cast, it portraits the bust of a woman after marble original by Francesco Laurana. The sitter has been tentatively identified as Ippolita Maria Sforza, the wife of King Alfonso II of Naples, but this theory is not based on any secure evidence. The 3D digitization was performed in 2001, at CNR in Italy using a Minolta scanner.
notes: Early structured-light digitization of a museum cast.
